findings.problema: Context retrieval failure. User asks for weather, zaelar retrieves daily agenda (calendar). Confusing unrelated context.
Looping/Repetition error. Repeats the start of the previous erroneous sentence ('Empiezas a las 9...') despite being interrupted/corrected.
Memory hallucination. Claims to know user has a 'Mazda' when user only said 'coche' (generic car). Also fails to recall car location when prompted at the end.
